Style: two character standing sprites for a Japanese-style visual novel, drawn as clean modern anime character art in a TV-anime cel look. Crisp, thin, even dark-brown line art with slightly tapered ends and a slightly thicker outer contour. Flat cel shading with exactly two tones per material: the base colour and one hard-edged shadow shape, plus a few small hard-edged highlights on the cap button, the nose and the eyes. A soft airbrushed pink blush on the cheeks is the only soft gradient. Large, glossy, expressive anime eyes with dark brown irises, one big white catchlight and one small one, clearly outlined so they read well inside the black face stripes. Simplified, rounded, appealing shapes; fur only as a few clean pointed tufts along the silhouette (cheeks, ears, elbows); the scarf knit suggested by a few clean lines. No fur texture, no fabric texture, no hatching, no grain. Even, neutral front lighting without cast shadows or scene light, so the sprites can be placed on any background. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a painterly or textured storybook illustration, not chibi, not watercolour.

Layout: exactly two figures side by side, the same character twice, each full body from the top of the cap to the feet and filling about nine tenths of the picture height, standing upright in front view and looking at the viewer, each centred in its half of the picture, the same size and the same baseline, with a clear gap of empty background between them. Both figures have exactly the same pose, body outline, clothes, head position and head angle: the parcel held under the arm on the left side of the picture, the other arm hanging relaxed, the satchel strap diagonally across the chest. Only the faces differ. Left figure: calm, friendly neutral expression, eyes open and looking at the viewer, eyebrows relaxed, mouth a small closed smile. Right figure: big happy smile, eyes closed into cheerful upward-curved arcs, eyebrows raised, mouth wide open in a laugh showing a little pink tongue, slightly stronger blush. No emote symbols, sweat drops, sparkles or motion lines (they are added separately in the game). Use the first attached image for the layout, pose, framing and size of both figures, and both attached images only for the character design: costume, colours of the clothes, face markings and body proportions. Line art, shading, eyes and level of detail follow this style description, not the references. Not a reference sheet with front, side and back views.

The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.

The figures are isolated on a fully transparent background.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Style: a background painting for a Japanese-style visual novel, like the hand-painted background art of a modern anime feature film. Clean, highly detailed 2D digital painting: crisp hard-edged shapes, sharp clean silhouettes, smooth clean colour gradients, small details (stones, planks, ropes, window frames) rendered precisely; no outlines. The sky is the main subject and fills the upper half of the picture: towering, sculpted cumulus clouds with crisp edges and long thin streaks of cirrus, the cloud undersides glowing peach, coral and pink from the sun that has just set, the cloud tops cool lavender and slate blue; a vivid gradient from deep ultramarine and violet at the top to warm orange and pale gold at the horizon; the first bright stars in the deep blue. Light: bright warm rim light and crisp edge highlights on clouds, roof edges, rocks and the lighthouse; cool blue-violet shadows; the calm sea mirrors the sky in long horizontal streaks. Saturated but harmonious colours, high clarity, strong contrast between warm light and cool shadow. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, no photographic texture, no film grain, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare, not an oil painting, not a watercolour, not a postcard.

Composition: eye-level view from the quay, a stage for a dialogue scene (a large character will stand in the middle and a dialogue box will cover the bottom quarter). The small stone cottage stands at the left edge (left 15 % of the width), the iron lantern on its wooden post just right of it at about 20 % of the width. The lighthouse on its rocky headland stands at about 84 % of the width, its lamp about one fifth of the picture height below the top edge. The middle of the picture (25 % to 62 % of the width) shows open quay, the calm sea, the horizon slightly below the middle of the picture and the big sky; the wooden jetty with the two boats runs out into the sea between 63 % and 78 % of the width. The lower quarter is plain paved quay with little detail. Effects are animated separately in the game, so do not paint them: the lighthouse lamp only as a small glowing spot without any beam, rays or halo, no smoke from the chimney, no birds, the lantern and the window lit but without a large glow, no sparkles on the water.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

In this picture the chimney shows no smoke and the lighthouse lamp has no beam: both are animated separately.

Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
